ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** turn Walkability on over ground built around cars on Explore's map and on a walk's map, and zoom in and out. **Expect:** the car ground draws as the slate hatch (`<Images>` with `assets/map/walk-hatch.png` at the phone's scale, `fill-pattern`, no antialiasing) with its 1 px slate edge, the lines about 9 px apart and crisp, the streets and labels readable through it; ground easy on foot is the plain map. (CG1, CG2, CG10)

argv: turn Walkability on over ground built around cars on Explore
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** zoom out until the edge of what was read shows beside car ground. **Expect:** the hatch fades out over about 100 m in steps, with no hairline between the steps and no edge line along the read's edge. (CG4)

argv: zoom out until the edge of what was read
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** with the layer on, navigate a route into ground built around cars, then switch the layer off and on, then End. **Expect:** the route's stretch through the hatch wears a slate casing between the white edge and the blue line (`route-car`, `beforeId="route"`), beginning and ending at the hatch's edge; gone with the layer off and at End. (CG6, CG11)

argv: navigate a route into ground built around cars
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** wait for the heads-up on that route, then open the legend. **Expect:** the pedestrian-with-car icon is slate in the heads-up and in the legend; the swatch is two slate lines with a thin slate edge. (CG5, CG7)
